requirements.title: Typed health observation with identity and freshness
requirements.description: Health reports carry deployment, target, observed release and configuration digests, observation time, typed check statuses and freshness; a healthy report can be too old or attached to the wrong release.

requirements.title: Consumers reject false-green health
requirements.description: Deployment Manager and other consumers fail closed on HTTP 200 with unhealthy, malformed, stale or wrong-target content and resolve the exact deployment from profile, environment and target rather than a hardcoded scenario slug.

requirements.title: Delivery-ramp evidence and exact review binding
requirements.description: Cloud implements the shared ramp seams; review, approval and publication bind to source, artifact, configuration, target set, environment, channel and policy; forged, stale or mismatched receipts are rejected.

requirements.title: Edge routing, DNS and TLS lifecycle
requirements.description: Public and private listeners derive from declarations; edge updates are transactional and preserve unrelated routes; certificate expiry and renewal produce actionable status; wrong DNS cannot claim external readiness.
